title: PRISM: Predictive Recomposition via Semantic Latent Decomposition for View-invariant Video Representation Learning
abstract: arXiv:2608.30388v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Cross-view video representation learning aims to capture viewpoint-invariant action semantics despite substantial appearance changes across egocentric and exocentric videos. However, existing methods encode each video as a unified embedding, where view-invariant and view-variant semantics inevitably entangle under co-occurrences - a failure mode we show persists even in cross-view methods explicitly trained for view-invariance. Our key insight is that a view-invariant feature is truly disentangled when it can be sufficiently recomposed with an arbitrary view-variant feature while preserving their independent semantics. Building on this, we propose PRISM, that decomposes video into view-invariant and view-variant latents and recompose them under language supervision encouraging clean decomposition of the two streams. translated_title: PRISM：基于语义潜在分解的预测性重组方法，用于视角不变视频表征学习
translated_abstract: 跨视角视频表征学习旨在从自我视角（egocentric）和第三人称视角（exocentric）视频中捕捉不受视角影响的动作语义，尽管两类视频之间存在显著的外观差异。然而，现有方法将每个视频编码为统一的嵌入向量，导致视角不变语义与视角相关语义在共现时不可避免地纠缠在一起——我们证明了这种失败模式即使在专门针对视角不变性训练的跨视角方法中也依然存在。我们的核心洞察是：只有当一个视角不变特征能够与任意视角相关特征充分重组、且同时保持二者各自的独立语义时，它才算真正实现了解耦。基于这一思想，我们提出了PRISM，它将视频分解为视角不变和视角相关两种潜在表征，并在语言监督下对其进行重组，以促进两个语义流的干净解耦。PRISM在EgoExo4D、EgoExoLearn、AE2数据集上取得了最先进的结果，甚至在零样本设置下超越了领域内模型。
tldr: PRISM通过将视频分解为视角不变与视角相关两种潜在表征，并在语言监督下验证其可重组性以确保真正解耦，从而在跨视角视频表征学习上取得最先进性能。
en_tdlr: PRISM decomposes videos into view-invariant and view-variant latents and recomposes them under language supervision to ensure true disentanglement, achieving state-of-the-art cross-view video representation learning.
